entries.title: Psalms 17:1
segments: ¶<A Prayer. Of David.> Let my cause come to your ears, O Lord, give attention to my cry; give ear to my prayer which goes not out from false lips.

entries.title: Psalms 17:2
segments: Be my judge; for your eyes see what is right.

entries.title: Psalms 17:3
segments: You have put my heart to the test, searching me in the night; you have put me to the test and seen no evil purpose in me; I will keep my mouth from sin.

entries.title: Psalms 17:4
segments: As for the works of men, by the word of your lips I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

entries.title: Psalms 17:5
segments: I have kept my feet in your ways, my steps have not been turned away.

entries.title: Psalms 17:6
segments: My cry has gone up to you, for you will give me an answer, O God: let your ear be turned to me, and give attention to my words.

entries.title: Psalms 17:7
segments: Make clear the wonder of your mercy, O saviour of those who put their faith in your right hand, from those who come out against them.

entries.title: Psalms 17:8
segments: ¶Keep me as the light of your eyes, covering me with the shade of your wings,

entries.title: Psalms 17:9
segments: From the evil-doers who are violent to me, and from those who are round me, desiring my death.

entries.title: Psalms 17:10
segments: They are shut up in their fat: with their mouths they say words of pride.

entries.title: Psalms 17:11
segments: They have made a circle round our steps: their eyes are fixed on us, forcing us down to the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 17:12
segments: Like a lion desiring its food, and like a young lion waiting in secret places.

entries.title: Psalms 17:13
segments: Up! Lord, come out against him, make him low, with your sword be my saviour from the evil-doer.

entries.title: Psalms 17:14
segments: With your hand, O Lord, from men, even men of the world, whose heritage is in this life, and whom you make full with your secret wealth: they are full of children; after their death their offspring take the rest of their goods.

entries.title: Psalms 17:15
segments: As for me, I will see your face in righteousness: when I am awake it will be joy enough for me to see your form.
